items.alias: Q6, guided token issuer (suggested U21 in the ruling; U21 was already used)
items.item: An external issuer for the guided internal tokens: one deliverable, three audience-scoped files. It writes the runner's STUDIO_RUNNER_GUIDED_CALLBACK_TOKEN_FILE and the backend's two controller token files (application.yml:200, :202 per the ruling). Tokens are RS256 and live at most 300 s (GuidedInternalSecurity.java:205-210). One issuer key verifies both roles, owning-worker and backend-controller (GuidedInternalSecurity.java:49-51, :196-201). The issuer refreshes Secrets mounted as directories (no subPath).
constraints: No in-pod minting: a signing key in the pod that renders untrusted pages could also mint backend-controller tokens (Gage's refusal, co-signed by Aria in Q6)
No sidecar: it breaks the one-container bound
No static Secret: a token expires within 300 s
